purpose: Recreate the exact CNGN Coinbase paper-trading dashboard and its dynamic hourly regime behavior.

non_negotiable_boundaries.asset_scope: all tracked stocks and crypto assets
non_negotiable_boundaries.historical_truth: verified forecasts created strictly before their target candle opened and resolved against provider OHLC
non_negotiable_boundaries.actual_candle_source: Coinbase Exchange OHLC for crypto, Yahoo OHLC for stocks, with any fallback explicitly labeled
non_negotiable_boundaries.crypto_paper_fill_model: Coinbase top of book plus configurable taker fee, adverse slippage, spread fallback, and product increments
non_negotiable_boundaries.spiral_down_guard: per-asset persistent execution pause with verified-metric recovery
non_negotiable_boundaries.alternation_control: forward-only BUY/SELL alternation evidence may KEEP, INVERT, or HOLD future execution
non_negotiable_boundaries.compression_candle_branch: RLE compression is a third execution branch focused on candlestick-to-candlestick state
non_negotiable_boundaries.late_wrong_mark_flip: a verified five-minute WRONG mark may flip execution one minute after its target candle closes

truth_contract.source_model: The timestamp-locked CNGN pair, direction, and change are immutable source facts.
truth_contract.forward_provenance: A confidence-bearing row must carry target_open, created_at, origin_boundary, horizon_step, rule_version, source=live_projection, forward_eligible=true, and a fingerprint; created_at must be strictly earlier than target_open.
truth_contract.legacy_exclusion: Historical table reconstructions and the legacy settled-results ledger are diagnostic only and may never influence confidence, inversion, sizing, or execution.
truth_contract.actual_market: Completed provider OHLC rows are the sole source of candle direction. Spot quotes may mark current price but may not create candles.
truth_contract.effective_execution: Future-only inversion and safety gates may transform or block the source model action, but must be labeled separately.
truth_contract.wallet_execution: Only a persisted paper-wallet event with executed=true may transfer value between cash and asset holdings. BUY executed_amount is total cash consumed; SELL executed_amount is gross notional sold; cash_delta is fee-net cash movement.
truth_contract.ledger_pnl: Every executed paper trade and event must carry side/trade_side as BUY or SELL. BUY affects cash, asset units, cost basis, holding value, open P&L, and equity. SELL affects cash, asset units, cost basis, realized P&L, total sold amount, and equity. Realized P&L is recomputed only from executed SELL ledger records with numeric realized_pnl.
truth_contract.sell_loss_limit: A paper SELL, including model boundary sells, replay sells, simple stop/take-profit sells, and dashboard cash-out sells, must preview realized P&L before changing cash, units, or cost basis. If preview_realized_pnl is less than or equal to -$100.00, the SELL is blocked as SELL BLOCKED · LOSS LIMIT $100.00, executed=false, amount=0, realized_pnl=null, loss_limit_blocked=true, and the wallet kitty and holdings remain unchanged.
truth_contract.wallet_reservation: Model requests, HOLDs, safety blocks, and NOT EXECUTED events reserve zero cash and zero asset units; the complete amount remains in the kitty.
truth_contract.cash_out_rebalance: A rotating on-screen four-digit confirmation PIN gates the dashboard cash-out action for the current paper wallet only. The PIN uses digits 1 through 4, is displayed beside the small PIN buttons, is validated server-side from a per-wallet local state file, and rotates after every successful cash-out. Cash-out sells the current paper asset position with the same modeled SELL fill assumptions, records the realized profit or loss in the ledger, backs up the prior wallet files, leaves the realized value in the cash kitty, marks the asset flat, sets cash_out_refill_pending=true, records cash_out_cash_kitty_reserve=$5,000 and cash_out_asset_refill_target_amount=$5,000, and waits before refilling asset exposure. A pending refill may be satisfied either by a later model BUY or by an explicit dashboard Buy back in button shown only while cash_out_refill_pending is true. The buy-back button immediately executes one paper BUY up to min($5,000, refill target, available cash above the $5,000 cash kitty reserve), obeys the configured minimum trade amount and modeled BUY fill assumptions, clears cash_out_refill_pending after a successful fill, leaves the protected cash reserve and any extra cash in the kitty, invalidates the asset live-output and cron-summary cache, and never places live Coinbase orders.
truth_contract.cash_out_rejoin_fee: Every dashboard reload must recompute and display cash_out_amount, cash_out_cash_kitty_reserve, cash_out_available_for_asset_refill, and cash_out_after_rejoin_fee as separate wallet-card stats. cash_out_amount is the raw cashout total stored from the cash-out event. While cash_out_refill_pending is true, estimate the rejoin fee by running the modeled BUY fill preview for up to min($5,000, refill target, available cash above the $5,000 cash kitty reserve) at the current price and execution assumptions, then show cash_out_amount minus that estimated fee. After rejoin executes, use the actual BUY fee from the paper ledger instead of the estimate.
truth_contract.boundary_idempotency: A five-minute boundary owns at most one persisted decision and at most one executed trade. Every decision has a deterministic key over asset, target boundary, locked forecast fingerprint and rule, selected evidence source and orientation, effective action, and safety-gate state. Refreshes and changing model views may not overwrite it with an opposite action.
truth_contract.historical_confidence: Raw RIGHT, WRONG, TOTAL, and RIGHT/TOTAL percentages remain visible even when an effective inverted percentage is used.
truth_contract.gaussian_confidence: Use a sample-aware normal approximation around the 50% chance baseline. The curve may change only future execution orientation and stake strength; it never rewrites historical rows.
truth_contract.observation_accuracy: Accuracy is a forecast-observation state built only from timestamp-locked guesses and completed provider candles. Executed, blocked, held, profitable, or losing wallet events are never consulted.
truth_contract.unscored_metrics: When TOTAL is zero, the percentage is undefined and every card must show an em dash or UNSCORED rather than 0% or 100%.
truth_contract.ui_reconciliation: Cards, charts, audit rows, trade ledger, cron summary, and live JSON must use the same source fields and labels.
truth_contract.portfolio_attribution: Portfolio P&L, passive 50/50 benchmark P&L, and strategy alpha versus that benchmark are separate values and must never be presented as interchangeable. Total wallet value may include the full cash kitty plus holdings, but Portfolio P&L is cash-neutral after cash-out: cash_out_refill_pending sets the active P&L basis to $0 and treats the cash kitty as neutral, while a later model BUY or dashboard buy-back sets the active P&L basis to only the amount actually bought back in from cash above the reserved $5,000 cash kitty, normally up to $5,000 asset exposure, not the whole $10,000 wallet.
truth_contract.spiral_guard: Each asset owns an independent drawdown circuit breaker. A paused asset creates zero-value HOLD events and cannot transfer cash or units until evidence-based recovery completes.
truth_contract.alternation_truth: BUY/SELL alternation is scored only from verified forward rows. A losing alternating branch may invert future actions, but historical rows and CNGN output are immutable.
truth_contract.compression_candle_branch: Pattern compression is an independent COMPRESSION_CANDLE execution branch. It reads the resolved candle-to-candle RLE state and the first-loop compression state without rewriting CNGN. When the effective selected action points opposite the dominant compressed BUY FAMILY or SELL FAMILY and compression influence is at least 50%, the execution guess is flipped to the compressed direction for exactly 12 five-minute marks. The event, phase card, live JSON, and idempotency key must label this as COMPRESSION CANDLE FLIP with pre-flip action, compressed action, score, threshold, and horizon.
truth_contract.late_wrong_mark_flip: A late-wrong-mark flip is execution-only. If the latest strict-forward five-minute forecast resolves WRONG, and wall-clock time is at or after target_open plus 300 seconds plus LATE_WRONG_MARK_FLIP_DELAY_SECONDS, the selected execution direction flips to the resolved actual direction. The event, phase card, live JSON, and idempotency key must label this as LATE WRONG MARK FLIP with pre-flip action, actual action, target time, and activation time. This guard does not rewrite CNGN, forecast rows, resolved rows, or historical counts, and it prevents compression branches from double-flipping the same boundary.
truth_contract.execution_ownership: An explicit Analyze request is one-shot in the browser. Browser refreshes are display-only; the scheduled five-minute worker is the authoritative recurring execution path.
truth_contract.scheduler_overlap: The portfolio worker owns a nonblocking process lock. A duplicate Windows or WSL invocation exits with OVERLAP_LOCK_ACTIVE before requesting any asset.
truth_contract.board_multiplier_average: The raw market average move remains a pure candle statistic. Current-board BUY average is raw average move times buy_multiplier; current-board SELL average is raw average move times sell_multiplier. Fallback display, replay, blocked-event labels, phase sizing, and persisted paper execution must use the side-adjusted average for the selected action, while chart candle geometry continues to use the raw average unless explicitly labeled as adjusted.

implementation_plan.name: Load the page and tracked assets
requirements: Read E:\coinbase\index.php first and preserve its named functions and state contracts.
Load the active ticker plus every tracked stock and crypto asset for background evaluation.
Keep scheduled processing active when the browser page is closed.
Acquire one nonblocking whole-portfolio worker lock before processing targets so duplicate scheduler invocations cannot overlap.
Keep OAuth credentials and any Coinbase credentials server-side; this page remains paper-only.
Use unauthenticated Coinbase Exchange five-minute candles and top-of-book quotes as the primary crypto market source; use Yahoo only as an explicitly labeled crypto fallback.
Fetch tracked crypto quotes concurrently and cache completed crypto candles to their five-minute boundary so dashboard refreshes remain responsive.

implementation_plan.name: Build the dashboard surface
requirements: Render the market pulse, current price, source, current action, model stance, wallet, phase status, confidence cards, compression card, audit table, trade ledger, chart, tracked-asset carousel, and controls.
Keep the page horizontally navigable for the portfolio cards and tracked assets.
Show requested stake, executed stake, zero reserved stake, available kitty amount, shortfall, locked event action, regime hour count, and time remaining in the phase.
Color each tracked-asset dashboard price green for UP, red for DOWN, and neutral for FLAT or unavailable, using the asset's hourly price direction.
Apply that same reconciled price and hourly direction class to the compact tracked-symbol cards at the top of the page.
Show a floating total-paper-portfolio card aggregating tracked-asset portfolio P&L and strategy alpha versus the passive 50/50 benchmark.
Render tracked assets as a snap-to-card carousel with five cards across on desktop and tablets and one full-width card on mobile phones; arrow controls advance exactly one card.
Keep horizontal movement inside the tracked-card carousel on mobile; its controls and other page sections must not create document-level horizontal scrolling.
Show SOLD or BOUGHT proceeds, fee, fill price, and net cash separately from realized P&L.
Use precise amounts and do not display an estimated dollar result as realized profit.
Show each asset's spiral guard status, drawdown, downward equity steps, realized-loss streak, recovery confirmations, selected confidence, and compression support.
Show BUY/SELL alternation raw history, effective percentage, Gaussian evidence, current four-action tail, and KEEP, INVERT, or HOLD decision.
Show model observation RIGHT/WRONG totals and the latest observed forecast result separately from executed-trade profit/loss.

implementation_plan.name: Create and freeze the signal ledger
requirements: Store each future guess before its target opens with target_open, created_at, origin_boundary, horizon_step, source, forward_eligible, rule_version, fingerprint, pair, direction, and immutable change.
Write confidence-bearing outcomes only to <SYMBOL>-forward-results-v2.json.
Require created_at to be strictly earlier than target_open; a same-boundary projection is display-only and cannot be scored or traded.
Keep reconstructed historical table rows source=historical_diagnostic and forward_eligible=false.
Preserve the legacy settled-results file for diagnostics but exclude all of its rows from confidence and execution.
Never replace an existing settled-result timestamp.
Read candle open and close from the same provider OHLC row.
Copy provider OHLC rows exactly into any fallback observation cache; never append a quote-derived flat candle.
Score only completed candles; a close above open is UP/green, below open is DOWN/red, and equal is FLAT/gray.
BUY is RIGHT only against UP; SELL is RIGHT only against DOWN; FLAT is not a win.
A completed zero-move candle is labeled FLAT and excluded from RIGHT/WRONG totals; it is never labeled UNRESOLVED.
If a row has a saved direction, that direction controls its audit action, chart action, and historical result.
Never rewrite old rows through a newer flip map.

implementation_plan.name: Calculate truth and confidence
requirements: Calculate every percentage as RIGHT / TOTAL * 100.
Calculate a percentage only when TOTAL is greater than zero; otherwise expose scored=false and render an em dash or UNSCORED.
Calculate BUY and SELL action cards from saved predicted directions, not the current map.
Calculate family confidence by saved BUY/SELL direction plus the intrinsic pair shape: same signs are AGREE and mixed signs are DISAGREE.
Calculate internal agreement from resolved table RIGHT/WRONG results over the recent 12 rows and all rows.
Calculate phase-action confidence from the first resolved candle of each phase.
Expose raw historical and effective inverted values separately whenever a metric is flipped.
For every binary confidence family calculate z = (RIGHT/TOTAL - 0.5) / sqrt(0.25/TOTAL), centered bell evidence = (2 * Phi(abs(z)) - 1) * 100, and a 0..1 stake multiplier.
Build every accuracy and inversion input from forecast-observation-v1 over cngn-forward-results-v2; do not read wallet events, trade count, fill status, or trade P&L.
Keep executed-exit PROFIT/LOSS counts in a separately labeled trade-performance state; never label them RIGHT/WRONG.

implementation_plan.name: Apply dynamic inversion
requirements: Use a stable baseline pair map to prevent flip cascades.
Require at least 6 samples and at least 50% centered Gaussian evidence before a confidence family may control execution.

For any scored right/wrong percentage card, when pre-inversion observation accuracy is below 50% RIGHT, mark observation orientation INVERT and display effective confidence as 100% minus raw. When above 50%, mark observation orientation KEEP. Exactly 50% or unscored remains observation HOLD.
Effective observation confidence is 100% minus raw historical confidence when observation orientation is INVERT, even when weak bell evidence keeps execution on HOLD.
Require at least 6 samples and the separate centered-bell evidence floor before that observation orientation may control a paper trade; display OBS orientation and EXEC orientation independently.

Use effective observation accuracy for forecast-response orientation and confidence display. Use execution orientation and its stake multiplier for sizing. Never feed the post-flip value back through the threshold or flip it a second time.

Apply the same Gaussian orientation to future backend execution, live JSON, and every right/wrong percentage card: accuracy, BUY, SELL, phase action, internal agreement, family confidence, quarter regime, and alternation evidence.
Injected observation, inversion, and removal rules are global program tasks. Wallets are accounting ledgers only and must not own private prediction-quality logic.

The tracked dashboard uses global-forecast-observation-v1 across every tracked asset for its displayed accuracy shape; it must not read one wallet's trade P&L or private cached accuracy as its truth source.
MIN_CONFIDENCE_EXECUTION_SAMPLES is 6 globally; do not leave any injected percent-card or execution gate using a private 12-sample threshold.

Compute globalWrongMarkBranches across all tracked assets by hour and 12-mark position. Include only positions that are WRONG on at least 3 tracked assets in the same hour, cap the list at 4, and branch that same list into each wallet state as global_wrong_mark_branches.

Compute late-wrong-mark flip state from forecast-observation-v1 latest only. If latest.result=WRONG and latest predicted/actual signs differ, mark the guard eligible; it becomes active at latest target_open plus 360 seconds.
Label affected displays HISTORICAL, EFFECTIVE, BELL evidence, z score, KEEP/INVERT/HOLD, stake multiplier, and FLIPPED when applied.
Select exactly one execution-evidence source in priority order: current verified BUY/SELL alternation branch, same-quarter regime, current family plus agreement shape, then all history.
Treat overlapping family, quarter, and aggregate evidence as one selected orientation; never flip twice.
Raw historical values remain available for audit and no-lookahead verification.

implementation_plan.name: Resolve the live action dynamically
requirements: Do not lock live execution permanently to one historical answer.
Expose modelAction, selectedExecutionAction, and executionAction separately so a model call, a selected future action, and an actual paper event cannot be conflated.

At each current regime boundary, recompute the effective action from the current formula guess, active regime, historical family confidence, internal agreement, inversion state, current candle direction, and phase timing.
Use the saved direction for historical rows but use the effective inverted direction for new or unresolved execution guesses.
If the selected Gaussian source is eligible, select KEEP or INVERT; if the sample or evidence floor is not met, HOLD.

After normal Gaussian inversion and before compression/takeover branches, an active late-wrong-mark flip must set the selected execution action to the latest verified actual direction and mark the selected evidence source as LATE_WRONG_MARK.
When late-wrong-mark flip is active, do not allow compression candle branch or compression-token takeover to flip the same boundary again.
A trusted current family branch with at least 85% effective confidence remains aggressive only when its Gaussian evidence is eligible.
After inversion, a BUY remains subject to the down-candle and same-quarter gate; a SELL is not blocked merely because its raw quarter branch was inverted.
Do not claim a future trade is guaranteed RIGHT; only completed candles can establish RIGHT or WRONG.

implementation_plan.name: Detect hourly regimes
requirements: Treat consecutive same-action calls as one directional regime.
Use twelve five-minute candles as one hour.
Convert the current forecast span into a regime count from 1 through 12 hours.
A new regime allocation executes immediately when detected.
After allocation, wait until the next top-of-hour before another allocation.
Do not allocate more than once per hour while the regime continues.
Reset the hourly allowance only when the hour changes or the regime changes.
Consume the phase/hour allowance only after an event executes. A blocked request remains unallocated and may retry on the next five-minute boundary.
Never execute or overwrite a second BUY/SELL at a boundary that already owns a persisted decision.

Generate execution idempotency keys under paper-execution-idempotency-v1 from market type, symbol, target boundary, locked forecast fingerprint, forecast rule version, selected evidence source, selected orientation, effective action, and gate state.
Persist the full idempotency key on the event and in a bounded per-wallet key registry; display a compact key in the audit label.
A change in low-accuracy inversion during a refresh cannot replace the settled boundary event. It becomes eligible only at a later boundary whose timestamp produces a new key.
If a key remains in the registry while its event is missing or damaged, create a nonexecuted IDEMPOTENCY HOLD rather than repeat the transfer.
Detect a four-call BUY, SELL, BUY, SELL or SELL, BUY, SELL, BUY tail from strict-forward forecasts.
Score an alternation occurrence only when a verified forward result completes that four-call tail.
If the alternating branch has eligible Gaussian evidence and raw accuracy below 50%, select it once as the execution source and invert the current future action.
If the eligible alternating branch is winning, KEEP its current future action.
If alternation evidence is unverified or ineligible, HOLD unless pattern compression supports the selected action with at least 50% influence.

When compressed-token influence is above 60% and has a BUY FAMILY or SELL FAMILY dominant direction, allow compression to take over the current execution action in that dominant direction with a bounded compression stake multiplier. Label the takeover separately from family, quarter, and alternation evidence.
Never stack an alternation flip on a quarter, family, or aggregate flip.

implementation_plan.name: Size the regime allocation
requirements: Use requested amount = regime hour count X average commitment X BUY or SELL multiplier X selected Gaussian stake multiplier.
The Gaussian stake multiplier is centered bell evidence / 100 when eligible and zero during HOLD.

When effective historical confidence is at least 85% and Gaussian evidence is eligible, enable AGGRESSIVE actions in the selected BUY/SELL direction and scale the commitment by a bounded confidence factor up to 2.0x.
Use the BUY multiplier for BUY and the SELL multiplier for SELL; never apply the wrong multiplier.
Apply the phase count once only; do not multiply again through sequence or bell-curve code.

Use one canonical sizing result containing requested_amount, available_amount, executable_amount, executed_amount, reserved_amount, shortfall, multiplier, regime_step_count, eligible, kitty_unchanged, gross_notional, fee_amount, net_cash_amount, fill_price, reference_price, spread_bps, and slippage_bps.
Do not impose a fabricated 90% confidence floor; confidence fields must contain measured values.

Globally normalize every positive BUY or SELL intent through exchangeFloorTradeRequestAmount before phase planning, replay, current wallet execution, audit labels, and live JSON. Positive intended trades below the active exchange minimum are lifted to that minimum; zero or NO TRADE intent remains zero. Carry minimum_funds and minimum_funds_source on sizing, fills, blocked events, phase cards, and live JSON.

Cap BUY by available cash. Treat requested and executed BUY amount as total cash consumed, including the modeled fee. For BUY minimum eligibility, compare the fee-inclusive cash spent to the active exchange minimum so a minimum committed BUY actually purchases units. After base-increment rounding, consume the committed BUY cash budget and account for the tiny remainder as modeled execution cost so the wallet buys the committed amount.
A phase-entry BUY may add the committed amount to an existing long position when cash is available; cost basis and units must update together.
Treat requested and executed SELL amount as gross notional. Credit cash with net proceeds after the modeled fee.
If SELL request exceeds held asset value, sell every executable unit permitted by the base increment and report the shortfall.

For current crypto fills use Coinbase bid for SELL and ask for BUY, then apply adverse configurable slippage. For replay fills apply half of the configured fallback spread plus adverse slippage to candle-open reference prices.

Default crypto paper assumptions are 60 bps taker fee, 5 bps adverse slippage, and 4 bps fallback spread; allow server-side environment overrides and label them as assumptions rather than an actual account fee tier.
Respect Coinbase base_increment, quote_increment, and min_market_funds when product metadata is available.
Every event exposes cash_delta and asset_units_delta. Both deltas are zero unless executed=true.
A nonexecuted event always exposes amount=0, executed_amount=0, reserved_amount=0, allocation_consumed=false, and kitty_unchanged=true.

Never execute below the active exchange minimum. For Coinbase crypto, use the product min_market_funds from Coinbase product metadata when available; otherwise fall back to the local MIN_TRADE_AMOUNT safety floor.

implementation_plan.name: Apply wallet safety and recovery
requirements: Require current price to exceed average cost by MIN_SELL_EDGE_PERCENT before selling.
When asset dust is below threshold after a full sale, mark the wallet drained.
Set rebuy_pending and buy up to $5,000 at the next boundary when cash is available.
Keep cash, units, cost basis, gross proceeds, net proceeds, fees, modeled slippage cost, realized P&L, open P&L, and equity separate.
Mark every wallet to the current reconciled quote and expose portfolio P&L, passive 50/50 benchmark P&L, and strategy alpha separately.
Expose reserved_cash=0 and reserved_asset_units=0, plus the currently available cash and asset units, in wallet state and live JSON.
Maintain a per-asset equity history of the latest 12 five-minute boundaries and count consecutive downward equity steps.

Pause an asset on a 2.00% hard peak-equity drawdown; on a 0.75% drawdown combined with strategy alpha at or below -0.50%; on four downward equity steps plus weak confidence or compression; or after two consecutive realized SELL losses totaling at least 0.25% of starting capital while portfolio P&L is negative.
While paused, block every model BUY and SELL, execute no reservation, and leave the complete kitty unchanged.

Continue evaluating verified metrics while paused. Recovery requires at least 6 verified samples, eligible effective confidence of at least 60%, combined compression of at least 55%, and a stabilized non-declining equity step.
Require two distinct top-of-hour recovery confirmations before rearming that asset, then rebase its drawdown peak and old realized-loss streak without rewriting its trade history.
Reset paper wallets only through the authenticated reset mechanism.

implementation_plan.name: Render the chart truthfully
requirements: Render real market candles separately from synthetic guess candles.
Build guess candles from the user's stored guess direction and stored change; use the active map only for unresolved guesses.
Each hourly prediction stick is a sequential path of exactly twelve five-minute locked directions.
Elastize each directional mark by the current observed average five-minute move; keep the original stored change separately and never alter the locked direction used for scoring.
Apply every mark to the prior synthetic close. Opposite marks cancel: +,- returns to the hourly open, and +,-,+ rests at the first positive level.
Expose the twelve-mark directionPath, directionSequence, per-mark elasticity, total elasticity, net directional steps, turns, persistence percent, and resting level.
Label chart shorthand in plain language: STEP is the current average five-minute price move and NET is positive marks minus negative marks.
Give each completed mark RIGHT, WRONG, or FLAT credit against its matching provider five-minute candle, then expose the hourly mark totals with the stick.
Only give the whole prediction stick RIGHT, WRONG, or FLAT when the hour is completed and both forecast and actual contain exactly 12 marks.
Treat a completed path with equal positive and negative steps as a locked flat/HOLD prediction; score it against the real hour instead of leaving it UNRESOLVED.
Keep a forming or mark-count-incomplete hourly candle UNRESOLVED and show GUESS x/12 and ACTUAL y/12 progress. Future sticks remain PENDING and show x/12 LOCKED.
For completed chart candles, compare the displayed guess direction directly with the displayed actual candle direction.
Mark completed predictions RIGHT or WRONG on the chart; use MIXED only for an explicitly aggregated mixed result.
Ensure candle color, BUY/SELL action, and RIGHT/WRONG label use the same locked direction.

implementation_plan.name: Render compression and diagnostics
requirements: Compute primary RLE compression from resolved directional sequence and first-loop compression at 50/50 weights.
Count UP and DOWN across the entire selected window; calculate the tail streak separately so entropy is not based only on the final run.
Use no more than 12 parts when reporting shortest and longest 100% compressed runs.
Use internal agreement as secondary compression at 30% of the combined score.
Show entropy, phase count, phase changes, tail streak, perfect-run bounds, secondary state, and combined score.

Treat compression and entropy as supporting diagnostics below the token takeover threshold. Above 60%, compressed tokens may become an actionable execution influence, selecting the dominant BUY or SELL family and exposing TOKEN TAKEOVER labels in the dashboard and live JSON.

Treat compression as a third COMPRESSION_CANDLE branch: when the effective selected action is opposite the dominant compressed candle family and compression influence is at least 50%, flip execution to the compressed direction for exactly 12 five-minute marks and expose pre-flip action, compressed action, score, threshold, and horizon.

implementation_plan.name: Refresh the complete page
requirements: Patch fast price values every 30 seconds.
After an explicit Analyze response, remove run_analysis and other one-shot response parameters from browser history before any automatic or manual reload.
Keep browser reloads display-only. Only a new explicit Analyze submission or the scheduled five-minute worker may request execution.
Refresh the complete live dashboard payload every 45 seconds.
At each live dashboard refresh, update tracked cards, the total paper portfolio float, current asset cards, tables, audit rows, wallet state, phase state, and tracked-asset prices from one snapshot.
Provide a visible Refresh button that triggers the same in-place live dashboard refresh immediately when pressed.
Use no-store/no-cache behavior for live JSON and page refreshes.

do_not_use_as_truth: current flipped map for historical rows
requested stake represented as executed stake
model directional edge represented as wallet P/L
portfolio P/L represented as strategy alpha

verification_plan: Run php -l E:\coinbase\index.php.
Run php -l E:\coinbase\wsl_portfolio_cron.php.
Validate E:\coinbase\strategy-spec.json with JSON parsing.
Verify every cngn-forward-results-v2 row has forecast_created_at strictly earlier than target_open and evidence_class=VERIFIED_FORWARD_ONLY.
Verify historical_diagnostic rows and legacy settled-results rows cannot enter accuracy, confidence, inversion, sizing, or execution.
Verify the live JSON declares evidenceSchema=cngn-forward-results-v2 and verifiedForwardOnly=true, with excluded legacy and unverified counts.
Verify crypto OHLC comes from Coinbase Exchange under normal operation and any Yahoo fallback is explicitly labeled.
Verify a 3.8% BUY card displays 96.2% effective confidence and raw 3.8% history.
Verify an inverted branch changes future execution but never rewrites resolved rows.
Verify the chart's displayed candle action and RIGHT/WRONG label agree.
Verify completed-candle direction reads both open and close from the same OHLC row.
Verify hourly prediction candles accumulate locked changes without actual-price drift.
Verify modelAction, selectedExecutionAction, executionAction, and the current paper event are explicitly distinguishable.
Verify raw and effective confidence values and counts are shown together after inversion.
Verify Gaussian evidence is 0% at 50% RIGHT, grows symmetrically toward 100% in either tail, and uses the declared sample count.
Verify any scored below-50% percentage card displays OBS INVERT and effective 100-minus-raw confidence, even below the execution sample gate.
Verify fewer than 6 samples or less than 50% centered bell evidence produces execution HOLD and a zero stake multiplier.
Verify 6 RIGHT out of 13 observations displays historical 46.1538%, effective 53.8462%, OBS INVERT, and EXEC HOLD when its bell evidence is below the execution floor.
Verify an eligible below-50% source applies exactly one future inversion while an eligible above-50% source keeps the source direction.
Verify execution evidence priority is current verified BUY/SELL alternation branch, then quarter, then family plus agreement, then all history, with no double flip.
Verify requested stake equals average commitment X regime count X side multiplier X Gaussian stake multiplier, with aggressive scaling applied only once.
Verify RLE entropy counts the full 12-part window rather than only the tail.
Verify a loss-protected SELL records a blocked event and does not mutate wallet balances.
Verify every nonexecuted event has zero amount, zero reservation, zero cash delta, zero asset-unit delta, kitty_unchanged=true, and allocation_consumed=false.
Verify a blocked request does not consume phase/hour allocation and can retry at the next five-minute boundary.
Verify a second opposite call at the same boundary leaves the original event, trade count, cash, units, and cost basis unchanged.
Verify the same asset, boundary, forecast fingerprint, evidence source, orientation, action, and gate state always generate the same execution idempotency key.
Verify executing, blocking, holding, or changing the P&L of a paper trade cannot change forecast-observation RIGHT, WRONG, TOTAL, orientation, or effective accuracy.
Verify the Model card shows observation RIGHT/WRONG and latest forecast observation while wallet trade outcomes are labeled PROFIT/LOSS.
Verify changing any one idempotency input generates a different key, but changing metrics on a refresh cannot replace the boundary's already persisted key or event.
Verify a consumed key with a missing event blocks execution instead of repeating cash or asset transfer.
Verify a new regime executes immediately, then cannot execute again until the next top-of-hour.
